_about: 21 October 2026: IBM AML HI-Small scored as Altman et al. (NeurIPS 2023, arXiv:2306.16424v3, Table 2) score it: the whole file (5,078,345 transfers) split 60/20/20 by time, F1 on laundering (1,797 in the last fifth), five runs (seeds 0-4) of validation/harness.py's fit (one LightGBM, 22 of the 28 features). 'chosen': the F1-peak cut-off on the middle 20%, as the harness does; 'at_0_5': a fixed 0.5. Each run is [F1, recall, precision] in %. 'published': the paper's Table 2 for HI-Small, mean and spread.
